$comment: AM5.1 labelled request set for the AI masking eval (plan/background-removal-ai/06 'AI masking', 11 'Evals').
labelling: Ground truth BY CONSTRUCTION, written by hand, not by a model. Each scene is a synthetic frame context: the detector hits the Subject Intelligence pack would return (label, normalised box, confidence, optional drift and visibility) plus the things on screen it cannot box (detector: null). Because the scene is built rather than observed, which thing each request means is known exactly. Labelling rules, fixed before any run: (1) 'target' — exactly one thing on screen matches the request's noun, or a plural/'all' request names a definite set, or a position/size word singles one out with centres at least 0.2 of the frame apart or at least 2x the area (no borderline positions are included); appearance words (colour) count as singling out, because a person looking at the frame can see them — such items are tagged requires='appearance'. (2) 'ask' — more than one thing matches the noun and nothing in the words singles one out. (3) 'face_selection' — the request depends on WHO someone is (a role such as host/presenter/guest, or an exclusion); plan 11 rule 6 makes the editor pick. (4) 'click' — the target is outside the detector vocabulary (plates, signs, sky, clothing, hair...); plan 11 makes this needs_click by design. (5) 'refuse' / 'typed_shape' — adversarial items where the scripted model misbehaves: nothing it invents may land; a shape the editor typed in the current request may. requires='object_class' marks targets the detector boxes only as a generic 'object'. Pack outputs are synthetic and follow the AM2.5 packs: every 'object' thing carries the COCO class Subject Intelligence >= 1.1.0 reports for it (a mug is COCO 'cup'), person detections are reported as class 'person', and a thing whose colour the scene states carries it, which the synthetic Visual Embed turns into a crop vector on that colour's axis. Classes and colours were added to the scenes as they are described, not tuned to any result.
